name: su-fenjingskill
title: 导演分镜 v3.1.6
job_to_be_done: 把完整剧本、连续场景、锁定片段或概念材料转换为按场景机制和导演方法组织的可拍、可剪六列文字分镜。

trigger_surface.description: 将剧本、连续场景、锁定片段或概念材料拆解为六列导演分镜和 director-shot-data/3.1.6；也用于比较导演方法，处理喜剧、群像、长对白长镜与平行剪辑。拆镜前确认节奏、时长、画幅和对白速度，再逐句决定切、留或镜内重构，以时间块测量并用整秒交付镜长；XLSX 是人类前端，其余三文件是同源 Agent 后端。
should_trigger: 完整理解这部剧本，再按导演和摄影师视角做六列文字分镜。
同一场戏按两种导演方法给出真正不同的剪辑方案。
把动作场面按目标、方向和因果拆成可拍分镜。
把连续场景做成固定四文件导演交付。
Design motivated shot topology, blocking, sound and a six-column director storyboard.
should_not_trigger: 把已有分镜编译成视频 Prompt。
根据 shot_data 生成分镜图。
只比较导演风格，不做分镜。
edge_cases: 用户未指定方法时最多提供两个实质不同的方案。
用户要求复刻具体镜头时只编译可泛化方法。
概念梗概必须登记 source gaps 与 assumption obligations。
中文角色标签、表演说明与实际口播必须分离。

steps: Build an exact immutable source ledger and protect narrative classification, facts, gaps and language authority.
Confirm Gate 0 rhythm profile, target runtime, aspect ratio, orientation, dialogue pace and coverage bias before shot design.
Identify one primary and at most one secondary scene mechanism.
Compile or confirm an executable director method.

Map every source dialogue turn to a dialogue edit plan, then resolve mechanism and method into protected processes, scene camera grammar, per-unit viewing design and trigger/editorial_gain boundaries before Gate 2.
Execute viewpoint, framing, aspect-ratio use, visibility, camera, staging, sound, edit, continuity, ordered shot_flow and recomputable timing blocks.

Render the Agent backend execution record and an independent XLSX projection that uses canonical Chinese shot-size terms and rejects redundant front-end source clauses, then approve Alignment for the current execution hash.
Atomically build and verify the fixed JSON, Markdown, XLSX and validation delivery.
decision_points: Never use source lines, speaker changes, duration thresholds or minimum-shot rules as universal cut generators.
Do not equate relationship scenes with two-shots, restraint with flat/fixed cameras, or category variety with directing quality.
Apply the single invalidation matrix: format → Gate 0/1/2/Alignment; source/method → Gate 1/2/Alignment; strategy/topology/dialogue plan → Gate 2/Alignment; execution → Alignment only.
Treat rhythm profiles as directing biases, never as fixed cut intervals or shot-count quotas.
Deliver every formal shot in whole seconds with a minimum of one second; retain fractional timing components only as measurement evidence whose total lands on that integer.
Treat one- and two-second shots as exceptional review items that require observable bounds and a concrete compression function, without a numeric quota.
Use target runtime only to reconcile the completed per-shot measurement; never allocate hold time backward from the target.
Treat hold_seconds as an independent silent, waiting or afterglow phase, never as the duration of an active dialogue/action block.
Formal shots may use only approved, bidirectionally bound director inferences.
Formal build is fail-closed and leaves no partial delivery.
failure_modes: Narrative content is relabelled as metadata to delete obligations.
Runtime accepts data rejected by the published Schema.
Camera, edit or continuity changes preserve an old Alignment.
Deleting assumptions incorrectly produces READY.
Topology references the wrong scene, passage or fact.
A shot has no explicit picture owner, visibility state or framing rationale, or repeats generic camera reasons across distinct units.
Multiple dialogue turns are hidden inside one static listener shot without per-turn visible development.
Dialogue, viewing, camera or boundary evidence differs only by IDs, shot numbers, quoted dialogue or boilerplate suffixes.
A claimed visible development is not realized in formal blocking, performance, focus, movement, effects or state updates.
Aspect ratio is selected after shot design or used as a generic movement ban.
Duration is a free-text guess rather than a recomputable timing plan aligned to shot_flow.
A formal shot is shorter than one second, uses a fractional final duration, or reaches an integer only through unsupported rounding.
A one- or two-second shot lacks observable start, end and compression-function evidence, or clusters without being surfaced for human review.
hold_seconds overlaps active dialogue, action, camera or reaction, or a positive component has no matching flow owner.
A vague type label is used instead of the fixed su-dialogue-pace/1.0 range, or a shot silently leaves that range without an explicit scoped override.
Subtitle reading CPS is incorrectly reused as spoken-dialogue articulation rate.
A non-standard shot-size label such as 紧中景 reaches the formal camera or XLSX header.
XLSX parity passes while camera setup, action, focus, ambience or edit-exit clauses repeat the same front-end information.
A partial output directory contains a premature READY validation.
Aesthetic statistics become hard failures.

eval_plan.baseline: runtime-only release; evaluation artifacts retained outside this package
